query:
UPDATE plans
           SET name = CASE WHEN built_in THEN name ELSE $2 END,
               description = $3, feature_set_id = $4, cpu_millis = $5, memory_bytes = $6,
               pids = $7, disk_bytes = $8, inodes = $9, bandwidth_bytes = $10,
               limits = $11, isolation = $12
           WHERE id = $1
